title: AIVale internal Run metadata foundation contract 1.0.0
description: Offline JSON projections of internal Go command values. This is not an HTTP request/response contract or a permission to execute a Run.

x-contract.version: version_id is an explicit fixed release belonging to the requested Agent and workspace. Agent must be active; the release must be published, structurally verified, hash verified and unrevoked. current, drafts, debug snapshots and other workspaces are not accepted.
x-contract.entry_point: CreateMetadata(ctx, workspaceID, agentID, input, requestID, repository)
x-contract.visibility: Internal, explicitly constructed metadata-only foundation. No public or management Run route is registered; runtime_ready remains false.
x-contract.authorization: A current management session, live Team/workspace membership and an active workspace are checked inside the short write transaction. Only admin/developer/operator role candidates qualify for this metadata-only path; this does not remove RunCreate resource-check requirements or authorize model execution. PAT and model Token identities are not accepted by this entry point.
x-contract.funding: A caller-owned, same-Team, enabled, unexpired model Token reference is checked transactionally by numeric ID. This foundation does not read its usable Key, inspect or change balances, reserve quota, or determine final model/tool/billing eligibility. caller_token_id is NULL for the management-session path.
x-contract.input: input must be one valid UTF-8 JSON object with no duplicate decoded keys, malformed Unicode, trailing document or non-JSON number. Raw and canonical forms are each limited to 60 KiB, depth is at most 16 (root=0), at most 4096 values/nodes are visited, each numeric source lexeme is at most 128 bytes and numeric exponents are between -308 and 308. Canonicalization preserves exact decimals and array order. The exact verified frozen release input_schema is applied inside the use case, with rational number comparisons. Raw input is never returned in the receipt or audit.
x-contract.metadata: Omission becomes {}. Business metadata is a flat object of at most 32 scalar values, with raw/canonical UTF-8 size at most 4 KiB. Keys contain 1..128 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL, and none of the case-insensitive reserved authority/secret names. Object and array values are rejected. Metadata is never used as authority, a funding override or an execution limit.
x-contract.effective_limits: No client limits are accepted. Stored limits come from the verified release and remain metadata upper bounds only. There is no reservation, consumption, settlement, model invocation or current-price assertion in this task.
x-contract.execution: New records are queued/production/manual with authorization snapshot admission=metadata_only. They have no execution admission, run.queued event, run_ready outbox, Worker claim or execution capability. P03 must complete runtime admission before such a record can be executed.
x-contract.atomicity: Run, completed run.create receipt and redacted run_metadata_audit v8 commit in one main-database transaction. No network call is made under the transaction. Rollback leaves none of these facts; a commit error does not authorize an automatic retry with a new key.
x-contract.idempotency: Reuse ag_idempotency_keys unique (scope_hash,key_hash). Scope binds Team, workspace, principal category/ID and operation; request fingerprint binds actual target Agent, fixed version, funding reference, canonical input and metadata. Reauthorize live before replay. Same key/same normalized intent returns the original immutable six-field receipt; a different intent conflicts. Retained expired keys are not recycled. Raw key is not persisted or audited.
x-contract.receipt: The six-field receipt reports only the original metadata creation. Its queued status is immutable acceptance metadata, not a fresh read of future Run lifecycle state. The stored receipt status is 201 internally; P03 public HTTP 202 admission is separate and is not implemented here.
x-contract.audit: run_metadata_audit schema version 8 uses aggregate_type=run and contains only actor/Team/workspace/Run/Agent/version references, fixed operation, revisions 0->1, request ID and timestamp. It contains no input, metadata, auth snapshot, credential, raw idempotency key, model instruction or trace body. Existing v1-v7 audit payloads do not accept run_id.
x-contract.archive: The presence of ag_runs keeps existing workspace/Agent archive dependency checks closed until the corresponding runtime drain adapters are implemented; zero counters are not proof that future Run resources are safe.
x-contract.wire_ids: The string IDs below document the offline JSON projection; Go command identity fields are typed positive int64 values. No client-supplied actor, Team, caller, trigger, mode, status, limit, lease, priority or trace field is accepted.

id.description: Canonical positive signed-int64 decimal string, maximum 9223372036854775807.

input.description: An inline JSON object; the frozen release input_schema supplies the actual data rules and the service enforces byte/depth/node bounds.

metadata.description: Optional flat business metadata; missing is canonicalized to {}. Raw/canonical UTF-8 byte limit: 4096. Every key has 1..128 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL or reserved authority name.

idempotency_key.description: One case-sensitive visible ASCII value. This internal command field is not an HTTP body parameter and is hashed before persistence.

result.description: Internal result projection only; expiry is the original retained receipt expiry, not execution admission or a public HTTP header.
